name: 回合制战斗、大招动画与打击感
notice: 战斗改为回合制：按速度轮流行动，轮到成员时选择普攻/技能/大招，敌人蓄力会提前一回合预警，20回合内获胜。大招播放角色动画，中间点击圆环评分（PERFECT/GOOD）。骰子选中改为抬起发光，计分骰子用霓虹框；去掉黄色光柱；普攻冒出的立绘缩小；护盾回到角色身上，应急守护用完后仍可见。
unityBuild: Unity 6000.6.0f1 WebGL R75: TurnBattle1020 (speed-ordered turns, 普攻/技能/大招, enemy telegraph next turn, 20-round limit, energy-gated ultimates) + TacticsBattlePanel.Turn1020 command bar; BattleUltimateShow1020 (character clip StreamingAssets/UltimateVideos/wubai-ult.mp4 or portrait, tap ring scoring); DiceRerollMark1020 lift/glow selection; dice neon frame instead of flames; ult pillar hidden; basic burst portrait 60%; guard ring placed on the portrait; spent guard badge stays visible.

validation.iosSimulator: iPhone 18 Pro simulator: turn battle from 开始挑战; 普攻 command, enemy turns with banner, auto mode through 15 rounds; 应急守护 used then still visible; all four ultimates with the show (雾白 plays her clip from the eye frame; others portrait), tap ring and MISS stamp.

knownLimits: 战斗音效仍为临时合成版。
普攻特效每个角色还没有各自设计。
开始演出转场新设计等待少爷从 A/B/C 概念中选择。
